purpose: The independently scoreable signed-in production denominator for Weekend RC 2026-08-30. It is separate from the deterministic CI manifest and permits no external fakes.

runtime_bindings.fixture_catalog: Gate 0 records exact synthetic object IDs, source hashes, selected model IDs and role bindings in redacted release evidence; credentials never enter this manifest.

employee_session.principal: authenticated lab employee bound server-side to the selected tenant and Agent
cleanup: archive or delete named synthetic Sessions and workspace artifacts through supported product paths

employee_knowledge.principal: authenticated lab employee and the same user's governed Personal Knowledge grants
allowed_effects: create personal import jobs and proposals
cleanup: archive/delete every synthetic personal document and verify no searchable ghost
retain source hashes and redacted citations only

company_governance.principal: authenticated lab company admin with server-derived publication authority
allowed_effects: grant and revoke synthetic test access
cleanup: retire or remove all synthetic company assets through governed lifecycle
verify employee search no longer returns retired fixtures

cross_role.principal: separately authenticated lab employee, company admin and scoped operator principals
allowed_effects: cancel synthetic active work after revocation
cleanup: revoke all temporary grants and operator reasons

collaboration.principal: authenticated lab employee with one persistent parent Agent and explicitly delegated peer scopes
allowed_effects: create synthetic child Sessions, team/workflow runs and A2A requests
cleanup: archive child Sessions and result artifacts without deleting audit evidence

external_capability.principal: authenticated lab employee or admin with the exact connector/trigger capability under test
allowed_effects: create disabled or bounded synthetic schedules/triggers
send only to an approved synthetic destination
pair/revoke only the designated lab Local Agent when currently authorized
cleanup: revoke temporary connector or Local Agent bindings
reconcile any ambiguous delivery before retry

release.principal: Codex release controller using owner-authorized production deployment scope
allowed_effects: deploy one frozen application commit to backend, backend-api and frontend
execute bounded lab-tenant synthetic E2E and cleanup
cleanup: preserve rollback target and redacted immutable evidence
do not mutate credentials, billing or irreversible production data

acceptance: one selected Agent completes an open-ended task through the real model/tool loop
the final deliverable satisfies an external hard criterion and is usable without admin intervention
negative_authority: denied effect does not remove unrelated reasoning or allowed tools
fault_recovery: disconnect and worker restart converge without duplicate input, effect or final answer
